AO No. 539 of 2015
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Sarvesh Agarwal, Advocate 
for the appellant. 
Heard. 
Appeal is admitted for hearing. 
Issue notice to the respondents. 
Steps be taken within a week. 
Call the Lower Court records. 
If the appellant deposits Rupees 
Two Lakh Fifty Thousand out of the total 
decretal amount, including the 
compulsory statutory amount, within six 
weeks from today before the Tribunal 
concerned, recovery in pursuance of the 
impugned judgment shall remain stayed 
till further orders of this Court. 
Stay application (CLMA No.12324 
of 2015) stands disposed of accordingly. 
List this appeal after service 
report is received. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 27.10.2015 Nadim

orders.text:
AO 539/2015 
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Sarvesh Agarwal, 
Advocate, for the appellant. 
Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate, 
for the respondent no. 1. 
In this case, the impugned 
judgment has been assailed on the 
ground of fake driving license of 
Mohd. Taufiq, who was also the 
owner of the offending truck at the 
time of accident and he was driving 
the same. Mohd. Taufiq presented his 
written statement before the Tribunal 
and has also cross-examined DW1, 
the official of the ARTO office, but he 
himself did not produce any evidence 
in this regard nor could present in 
the witness box. 
I think the service upon 
respondent no. 2 Mohd. Taufiq 
should be made effectively wherefor 
steps shall be taken within a week. 
List after service is effected. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 7.7.2017 
Prabodh
